open_points.subject: issue_contract_version
open_points.text: issue_contract_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise RefusedError naming the first failing check, in this order: a new slot_id with purpose None, or an existing slot whose purpose differs from a given purpose; port names repeat within a direction; an input port without a disclosure class or an output port with one; a file port without exactly one media type or a value port with one; a value_schema outside the supported subset; no output port; a resource bound that is None, not a positive integer, or above its release ceiling, the refusal naming the field and the ceiling; ports are taken inputs first then outputs, each by name.
open_points.other_text: an existing equal contract version is returned unchanged even when a later release lowered a ceiling below its bounds (A01 rule 4, A20 rule 4).
open_points.question: Must an existing equal contract version whose bounds exceed a current release ceiling be refused as required by the validation rule, or returned unchanged as required by the existing-version rule?
